title: Associate
jobDescription:
As an Associate – Company Secretary & Compliance, you will support the Company's corporate governance, secretarial, and regulatory compliance functions. You will assist in organizing Board, Committee, and Shareholder meetings, preparing meeting documentation, maintaining statutory records, and ensuring timely filings with regulatory authorities such as the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), Stock Exchanges, SEBI, and RBI. The role also involves supporting compliance under SEBI Listing Regulations, Insider Trading Regulations, FEMA/RBI requirements, and other applicable laws. You will assist in the administration of ESOP/RSU programs, investor services, annual report preparation, and coordination with auditors, registrars, regulatory authorities, and internal stakeholders. Additionally, you will help monitor compliance across the Company and its subsidiaries, maintain compliance tools and records, and contribute to strengthening governance and compliance processes. An Associate – Company Secretary & Compliance will support corporate governance and regulatory compliance activities, ensuring adherence to the Companies Act, SEBI regulations, RBI/FEMA requirements, and Secretarial Standards. The role involves coordinating Board and Committee meetings, managing statutory filings and records, supporting ESOP administration, investor services, and liaising with regulators, auditors, and key stakeholders to ensure timely and effective compliance. Compliance under the Companies Act, 2013 and other allied acts Ensuring timely and strict compliance with the requirements of Companies Act, 2013 and Rules made thereunder + other allied Acts including compliance under Secretarial Standards of ICSI. Organising Board / Committee / General Meetings including issue of Meeting Notice, preparation of Agenda, compilation of necessary documents, organising meetings, preparation of Minutes and action taken report and all other matters in connection therewith. Matters related to appointment of Board of Directors / Key Managerial Personnel and all activities relating thereto. Filing of necessary forms / returns with Ministry of Corporate Affairs including publication of statutory notices. Matters related to Meeting of Independent Directors and Board Evaluation Process. Printing & Mailing of Annual Report: Co-ordination with internal / external stakeholders and compiling necessary inputs for preparation / finalization of various sections of Annual Report viz., Boards’ Report, Corporate Governance Report, Notice of AGM, Business Responsibility & Sustainability Report, Management Discussion & Analysis Report etc., liaisoning with Agency and Printer for printing and mailing of annual report to shareholders. Maintenance and updation of statutory registers and records Compliances under Regulations of SEBI / Stock Exchanges Ensuring timely compliance with the requirements of SEBI Listing Regulations, SEBI Prevention of Insider Trading Regulations / Takeover Code, and other regulations / circulars / notification of SEBI / Stock exchanges, as applicable to a listed company. Filing of necessary forms / returns / intimations on periodical basis with SEBI / Stock Exchanges, including publication of statutory notices / financial results. Administration of Tool for Prevention of Insider Trading, Maintenance of Structural Digital Data under SEBI PIT Regulations and all matters related thereto. Compliances under RBI / FEMA Regulations Filing of necessary forms / returns with RBI / Authorised Dealers in relation to Allotment of Shares / Employees’ Stock Option Plans etc, Administration of Employees’ Stock Option Plans / RSUs Attending to activities relating to grant of options under ESOP / RSU Plans, obtaining Board’s / Committee’s approval, allotment of shares, effecting corporate action thru NSDL / CDSL for crediting of shares to allottees and listing of shares on stock exchanges with necessary trading approvals. Liaisoning with External Stakeholders Liaisoning with Statutory Authorities viz., Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Stock Exchanges / SEBI / Registrars & Transfer Agent and Dividend Bankers and attending to all matters related thereto. Liaisoning with Secretarial Auditor, Statutory Auditors, External Consultants in relation to Secretarial Audit / Corporate Governance Audit / Statutory Audit and attending to all matters related thereto. Investors’ Services Shareholders Management – Transfer / Transmission of Shares, Issue of Duplicate Share Certificates, Demat / Remat of Shares, Redressal of Shareholders’ Grievances, Mailing of Annual Report to Shareholders, etc. Dividend disbursement / administration including transfer of unclaimed dividend and shares to Investors’ Education and Protection Fund Management / Administration of Secretarial / Compliance related Tools Other Compliances Managing compliance activity of the Company & its subsidiaries (both India and abroad) to ensure that all regulatory requirements at entity level is complied with, including streamlining and monitoring the compliance mechanism, obtaining compliance certificates periodically from internal stakeholders, reporting on compliance to the Board, and advising / taking remedial action to address issues, if any. Mandatory Skills: Qualified Company Secretary, preferably with law graduation with 2 – 4 years of experience in handling company secretarial & compliance related matters of a listed company. Comprehensive understanding of Acts, Rules & Regulations and ensuring strict compliances. Good communication & presentation skills, interpersonal & relationship building skills with exposure in interacting with various statutory authorities, for timely redressal of various issues. Experience: 2 to 4 years’ experience in handling company secretarial & compliance related matters.

EDUCATION:
Graduation Degree in Law or an equivalent qualification.

title: Senior Manager
jobDescription:
Thorough understanding of electronics Supply chain dynamics, OEM/ODM Models Thorough knowledge about suppliers’ base, market prices and manufacturing process for Electronics, Telecommunication and wireless products. Strong negotiation skills. Expertise in Routing & BOM structure analysis Expertise in MS Office (Excel, Power Point) Expertise in data analysis Team Leadership The Supply Chain Management (SCM) team is at the forefront of driving efficiency, fostering collaboration, and ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction. As a leader in the telecommunications industry, we have a clear SCM vision that not only differentiates us but also fuels our growth and innovation. By joining our dynamic team, you will play a pivotal role in revolutionizing supply chain practices, contributing to operational excellence, and shaping the future of telecommunications. If you’re a talented and driven individual looking to make an impact, we invite you to apply and be a catalyst for success at Tejas Networks. Lead full end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes, including requisition-to-PO conversion, supplier selection, RFQ/RFP issuance and evaluation, and contract finalization. Expertise in negotiating and closing Master Service Agreements (MSAs), Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) costs, Manufacturing Value Add (MVA) pricing, repair/rework terms, and process change revisions. Proven ability to validate technical and cost requirements in collaboration with manufacturing, industrial engineering, and quality teams. Onboard, develop, and manage global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) and Contract Manufacturers (CM) partners, including multi-location capacity ramp-up and performance alignment. Build and execute multi-sourcing strategies to mitigate single-source risks, track committed capacities, and drive supplier output improvements through regular follow-ups, site visits, and joint planning Negotiate extended payment terms, volume-based pricing, and cost structures to achieve targeted soft/hard savings through MVA optimizations, NRE closures, and process efficiencies. Benchmark supplier proposals and performance against industry standards; identify and implement cost-reduction opportunities while maintaining quality and delivery standards. Proactively identify and mitigate supply chain risks, including supplier disruptions, capacity constraints, geopolitical factors, and material shortages. Ensure ESG compliance, vendor audits, regulatory adherence (telecom-specific standards), and ethical sourcing practices. Develop contingency plans, track recovery actions for critical items, and maintain business continuity through diversified sourcing and performance monitoring. Mastery-level communication skills for preparing and presenting stakeholder updates, daily reports, and cross-team coordination. Expert teamwork and collaboration to drive collective ownership, motivate teams during crises, and foster positive working relationships with internal and external partners. Strong management and leadership skills for ethical decision-making, team mentoring, performance guidance, and maintaining a proactive, solution-oriented attitude under pressure. In-depth background in telecom hardware supply chains (e.g., radios, baseband units, optical network terminals, cables, enclosures, and related mechanical/electronic components). Experience managing partners and sourcing in emerging and global markets, including Asia-Pacific, China, India, and EMEA regions. Familiarity with consigned/turnkey manufacturing models, repair/rework services, and high-volume telecom project execution. Conduct Periodic Suppliers Audits and supplier performance rating along with the quality team Initiate and drive the quality system requirements (ISO9000/TL9000/ ISO14001/OHSAS 18000) for suppliers and maintain the records for Internal and external audits by customers’ / ISO certification auditors, Experience: 15 to 20 years in Electronics and/or Telecom

EDUCATION:
BE – Electronics & telecommunications or Equivalent

title: Specialist
jobDescription:
We are looking for a skilled SAP MM (Materials Management) Consultant with 5+ years of experience in SAP MM implementation and support projects. The consultant will be responsible for configuring and supporting procurement and inventory management processes while working closely with business users and technical teams. The SAP-ERP team will be responsible for managing and optimizing the company's enterprise resource planning (ERP) system using SAP. The primary duties include overseeing modules related to but not limited to finance, supply chain, production, and human resources to ensure seamless integration across departments. The team will ensure that business processes are streamlined, data is accurate, and reports are generated efficiently. Additionally, we support cross-functional troubleshooting, upgrades, and enhancements of the SAP system to meet organizational goals. Participate in SAP MM implementation, rollout, and support projects Analyze business requirements and provide SAP MM solutions Configure procurement processes: PR, RFQ, PO, Contracts Configure Inventory Management and Physical Inventory Manage Vendor Master and Material Master data Support Invoice Verification (MIRO) processes Work on MM integration with FI/CO, SD, and PP modules Configure pricing procedures, release strategies, and workflow approvals Support SAP S/4HANA MM capabilities including Fiori applications Prepare functional specifications and coordinate with ABAP team Perform unit testing, integration testing, and UAT support Provide L2/L3 production support as required Experience: 5+ years of hands-on SAP MM consulting experience

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, or Management

title: Senior Manager
jobDescription:
Initiate and monitor cost reduction drive with the supplier for project-based and Yo Y to achieve cost reduction and be competitive in the market Consistently create cost effective supplier base and overcome single supplier dependencies BOM analysis for cost contributors and initiate cost reduction program Timely working out the latest Product cost and sharing with the Deal desk for bid/quote to customers Periodic updating of the product BOM cost for the latest parts cost and sharing reports with the Deal desk Conduct period supplier audits and supplier rating Measuring, Monitoring & Improving the suppliers' performance on Quality, Cost & Delivery To lead & effectively manage the Sourcing, Buying and BOM costing process of Active electronic components at Tejas. Identification, Evaluation and selection of cost-effective suppliers in line with the Tejas Sourcing process Create a pool of cost-effective alternative suppliers for each part to bring the flexibility in terms of Cost, quality and delivery. Get competitive quotations, compare technical specifications and commercials, negotiate and finalise the prospective suppliers' base. Initiate the sample purchase, get samples from suppliers, and coordinate for sample evaluation and acceptance Initiate and drive cost reduction program for Yo Y cost reduction and project-based cost reduction Update the latest parts cost in the product BOM cost and share with the Deal desk on a regular Intervals Analyse the BOM, identify the cost contributors and initiate the cost reduction program Initiate and drive the Value Engineering process to bring down the cost Conduct Periodic Suppliers Audits and supplier performance rating along with the quality team Initiate and drive the quality system requirements (ISO9000/TL9000/ ISO14001/OHSAS 18000) for suppliers and maintain the records for Internal and external audits by customers’ / ISO certification auditors, Ensure that the selected suppliers meet the quality system requirements (ISO9000/TL9000/ ISO14001/OHSAS 18000) Ensure that the various Sourcing and BOM costing KPIs and parameters are achieved and continually improved To train and develop the Sourcing & Procurement management team members to the required skills continuously Experience: Min 15 to 20 years in Sourcing, BOM costing, and cost management domains in Electronics and Telecom

BE – Electronics & telecommunications or Equivalent

title: Manager
jobDescription:
To ensure that a high level of On-time Delivery performance are maintained and improved to achieve customer satisfaction. Strengthen Contract manufacturer's engagement, Improve delivery performance and Yield, Initiate and monitor cost reduction drive with contract manufacturers to achieve Yo Y cost reduction Timely and systematic closure of the Contract manufacturer's greeneries, like E&O, Price variances, shortages Measuring, Monitoring & Improving the Contract manufactures performance on Q-C-D . To lead & effectively manage the Wireline Programs at Tejas and achieve Internal and external Customer satisfaction through a timely and continuous supply of material from contract manufacturers (CM’s) at optimized cost and with the right quality. The target is to have world-class customer delivery satisfaction. Set-up the Program management systems & processes with CM’s in line with the Tejas manufacturing process Model to achieve customer satisfaction. Achieve highest levels of delivery performance for Cards, sub-assemblies, and products from CM’s Effectively manage the assigned Programs as per the business processes to meet and exceed the customer requirements. Drive and ensure that long term forecast is shared with CM’s to provide enough visibility for them to plan production capacity and materials Drive and ensure that the CM’s loads Tejas demand in their MRP systems and timely release of Purchase orders on suppliers for parts. Achieve highest levels of delivery performance for NPI Cards, to achieve the timely go-to market strategy Ensure that the various Program management & Operational KPIs and parameters are achieved and continually improved Minimizing and systematic handling of Contract manufacturers grievances by timely addressing and resolving. To establish and manage a highly professional and strategic relationship approach with CM’s for consistent and seamless supply of products and services. Set up Quarterly Business review meeting with CM’s to monitor their performance & KPI’s MIS / Reporting, Communication within SCM team, Service Team, Design & Production teams and also generate Weekly, and Monthly reports like, CM’s delivery performance, Yield, CTB / Shortages forecast accuracy. RMA, Excess & Obsolete Inventory and Contract manufacturer monitoring related reports in line with TL9000 Experience: Min 10-15 years in manufacturing domain – Electronics / Telecom production or EMS companies
